items.text: Auto dice has two more options, Shuffle locks and Wander weave. Each automatic roll can first lock a few random rows and columns (so a little of the last scene carries on, never everything) and pick a weave preset or none. Turn the robot and auto dice on, go to play view, and it composes on its own.
In the play view, holding the robot opens a slim vertical list of the line-ups instead of the whole heads-up display, with a close button. The heads-up display also has a close button now.
changed: The return icon stays in exactly the same place when the play view settles into full screen.

changed: Three views now: the regular view, the play view (the button in the record group) and the full screen (a few quiet seconds later, only the grid and the return icon). The play view saves the side gutters so the grid is as wide as the screen allows, the return icon sits on the same row as the bottom bars, and the tempo bar stretches across the free width.
changed: When the phone zooms the grid, the grid lines stay as thin as before; only the marks get bigger.
changed: The stay-awake icon in the top right no longer shows in full screen.

changed: Full screen is now the last button in its group (export moved in front of it). Pressing it makes it fly to the lower right corner and pulse. The right menu, the duck-rabbit and undo/redo slip away, the score grows, and the scene, record and tempo controls stay low. After a few quiet seconds only the full-screen icon is left; tap it, or the strip where the controls were, to bring them back. Tap it again to leave full screen.

fixed: Send to field did nothing on touch screens. Every time a finger lifted, the app let go of held notes too, so by the time you pressed send nothing was held. Held notes now stay held until you let them go, and you can drag them for volume and reverb.
The zoomed full-screen view on a phone is now playable and tunable. Touch the big grid to play, hold, shape and send; a small button at the bottom brings back all the controls.
changed: The send-to-field button is now the field icon with a plus over its lower right corner.
fixed: In the phone full-screen view the glowing play column outside the grid sat off to one side of the one inside it. The background effects layer now scales with the grid, so they line up.

On a phone, in full screen, when the controls fade away the grid now grows to the largest size the screen can hold, centred, with the guide lines running to the edges. Touch the screen and it settles back and the controls return. (Only the picture is scaled; nothing about the score changes.)
fixed: Send to field now says why when it cannot send (sound not awake yet, nothing held) instead of doing nothing.

The Bed is now made from the instrument's own sound. It keeps the last four seconds of what you just played and scatters short grains of it, so a crowd that has to be folded sounds like a cloud of itself, not like noise. If a browser cannot do this it keeps the old noise bed.

How crowded it may get. Four settings in the Soniscale panel: Clear (every note plays as itself until the device is full, how it has always been, and still the default), Rich (a crowd sits as a softer, spread layer), Dense (everything past a dozen sounds goes into the Bed) and Cloud (only a few notes play, over a Bed that is always there). The listener limit is estimated from how different and how regular the recent sounds are. Tuned by ear, so tell me which one feels right.
